description: This file is a shell script that implements IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnel setup, specifically for 6to4 tunneling. It contains functions to initialize configuration, set up and tear down the tunnel, and handle related networking tasks.

methods.name: find_6to4_prefix
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 address to a 6to4 IPv6 prefix.

methods.name: test_6to4_rfc1918
methods.description: Tests if an IPv4 address is within RFC1918 or RFC6598 private address ranges.

methods.name: proto_6to4_setup
methods.description: Sets up the 6to4 IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnel with specified configuration.

methods.name: proto_6to4_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the 6to4 tunnel (currently a placeholder).

methods.name: proto_6to4_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration for 6to4 protocol, defining necessary parameters.
